description: Enhance the JSON object decoder to safely handle unserialized objects by validating exception types before instantiation and gracefully handling unimportable classes. This will prevent runtime errors when decoding malformed or unsafe JSON data.
functional_requirements: Validate that '__exc_type__' values resolve to BaseException subclasses before attempting to instantiate exceptions
Handle unresolvable class names in the '__class__' branch by returning the raw dictionary instead of raising errors
Add comprehensive tests covering both valid and invalid inputs for each decoder branch to ensure robustness
